rv.q: Among her works, A Vindication of the Rights of Woman is a foundational feminist text. After that, giving birth to Mary Shelley seems like a postscript. Maureen Lennon’s patchwork tribute for Hull Truck and Pilot theatre is a musical collage of fast-paced scenes designed to memorialise a pioneer of sexual equality.
Mary and the Hyenas is undoubtably a show I’d happily go and see again, so I think it’s safe to say I think I’ve found at least one of my musicals.
